echoParts: And being found in human form
verseText: And being found in human form, he humbled himself by becoming obedient to the point of death, even death on a cross.
meaning: Though Jesus deserved to be treated like a king, he chose to become a lowly human and suffer the dreadful death of the cross in order to save us.
